value.rationale: The exact stabilizer indices, full-rank congruence kernel, inseparable finite invariant extension, and complete finite-field conjugacy enumeration answer natural structural and counting questions for a uniform modular Laurent family. In particular, the determinant ±1 image of integral automorphisms forces a substantive orientation splitting for full-rank weights when p≥5, absent from characteristic-zero intuition.
